description: Finds personal data in a .docx or text file (or in `text`) and replaces it: names after titles and court roles (Mr., Frau, domnul, reclamantul…), addresses, national ID numbers checked by their control digit (CNP, PESEL, EGN, TC Kimlik, DNI/NIE, codice fiscale, NIR, SSN, NINO, rodné číslo), ID card and passport numbers, dates of birth, e-mails, phones, IBANs and cards, licence plates and IPs; companies and places on request. The same person always gets the same label ([Person 1]). Word files keep their formatting; author fields are cleared. Rules only (no AI model), so names with no title before them are found only when they also appear after one, or via `terms`. The originals are never returned: only counts, so the result can be shown to a model safely. Run it before reading a confidential file.

hide.description: Kinds to hide; default all but organization and location

keep.description: Found values to leave as they are (e.g. the court, the lawyer)

key_output.description: Also write a CSV key (label -> original) here, to reverse it later. Keep it apart from the document.

language.description: Language of the labels ([Persoana 1], [Person 1]...); default en

output.description: Where to write the result; default <name>-anonymized next to the input

style.description: label: [Person 1] (default); initials: P.I. for names; mask: █████

terms.description: Words or phrases to hide everywhere too (names, nicknames, case numbers)

name: document_anonymize
title: Anonymize a document
